[[File:BorisKholodenkoFotoThalerTamas.JPG|thumb|Boris Kholodenko, 2014]]

'''Boris N. Kholodenko''' is a Russian professor of [[Systems Biology]] at [[Systems Biology Ireland]] and Conway Institutes at [[University College Dublin]], Ireland. He is also an [[adjunct professor]] at [[Thomas Jefferson University]], Philadelphia where his group was behind the development of the first model of [[Epidermal growth factor receptor]].<ref name=cellnetworks>{{cite web|url=http://cellnetworks.org/nav.cgi?page=bkh|title=Boris Kholodenko|accessdate=June 12, 2013}} {{Dead link|date=January 2015}}</ref>

==Biography==
Boris Kholodenko graduated from [[Institute of Physics and Technology]] from [[Moscow]], Russia where he got his Ph.D. He used to be a professor and director of Computational Cell Biology at Thomas Jefferson University in [[Philadelphia]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ucd.ie/sbi/peoplepartners/profiles/boriskholodenko/# |title=Boris Kholodenko |publisher=Systems Biology Ireland |accessdate=June 12, 2013 |archivedate=March 6, 2013 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130306103031/http://www.ucd.ie/sbi/peoplepartners/profiles/boriskholodenko/%23 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In 2018 he was admitted as a member of the [[Royal Irish Academy]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ria.ie/news/membership/28-new-members-elected-royal-irish-academy |title=28 New Members elected to Royal Irish Academy |work=Royal Irish Academy |date=25 May 2018 |access-date=27 Nov 2021}}</ref>
